# Portfolio quality-control report

**Generated by** `portfolio/src/qc_check.py` (8 November 2026). It re-reads the frozen sources, checks every portfolio number and required caveat, scans all portfolio-facing text for forbidden claims, and validates the presentation, PDF and diagram files. No model was fitted and no frozen file was changed.

**Result:** 390 checks, 390 PASS, 0 FAIL.

Portfolio-facing text checked: slide text and speaker notes (`portfolio/src/make_deck.py`), `portfolio/SPEAKER_NOTES.md`, `portfolio/README.md`, `docs/PORTFOLIO_PRESENTATION_BLUEPRINT.md`, and the diagram text in `portfolio/src/make_diagrams.py`.

## Notes on interpretation-level checks

- Forbidden-claim checks are pattern-based. A pattern preceded within 40 characters by an explicit negation (for example "not resolved") is accepted.
- The blueprint's "claims to avoid" lists describe errors without quoting them and are therefore scanned like any other text.
- The PPTX was validated by re-opening it programmatically (slide count, notes, pictures, text). Visual layout was checked on the matplotlib-rendered PDF pages, which use the same slide geometry; every PDF page was rasterised with macOS sips and inspected. PPTX visual inspection is BLOCKED: Keynote and PowerPoint are installed, but a scripted Keynote export timed out (AppleEvent -1712) and Quick Look produced no render, so the PPTX must be opened manually once (see the acceptance report).

## Discrepancies with the research record

None found.
